text:
maria: Heads-up: I'm assembling a tiny docs PR to update streaming snippets for SDK v1.12+ — goal is quick migration help for callback-based integrations. Need micro-examples for Py/TS/Go.

aj: Thumbs up. Keep examples super short (3-6 lines). Show the new iterator pattern and a tiny adapter that calls an `on_message` callback so integrators can paste it.

leo: For TS, show `for await (const part of client.stream(...))` then a one-liner `const adapter = (cb) => (async () => { for await (const p of it) cb(p.text) })()` style.

maria: Good. For Python: show `async for chunk in client.stream(...)` then a tiny helper `def shim(on_message): asyncio.create_task(_pump(on_message))` — also comment about not hiding retry backoff inside the shim.

aj: Add a Go snippet using `for { msg, err := stream.Recv(); ... }` and a small `WrapStream(ctx, handler)` that spawns a goroutine. Call out `context` so users can cancel.

leo: Also include a line about pagination — if your stream returns continuation tokens, the adapter should surface them to the caller, not swallow them.

doc-bot: Suggestion: include minimal manual test commands in PR description so reviewers can sanity-check snippets (no CI runtime). Example: `node -e "console.log('ok')"` or `python -c 'print(\"ok\")'`.

ci-bot: Creating branch `docs/stream-adapter-tips`. Running docs-lint and snippet linter.

maria: Pushed draft PR 7 — files under `docs/snippets/migration/stream-adapters/`. Link: https://git.example/redwood/docs/pull/7 (WIP).

aj: Quick nit: rename `on_data` -> `on_message` everywhere. Also add an explicit SDK version callout: "requires SDK>=1.12.0".

maria: Fixed names and added the SDK callout. Also added one-line comments in each shim: "keep retry/backoff outside this adapter".

leo: LGTM after small typo fix.

ci-bot: Lint passed. docs-snippet-check: warnings: 1 (long line in TS snippet).

doc-bot: Please add a short migration note to the Release Notes doc linking the snippets.

maria: Added release note and a changelog bullet about "streaming API: new iterator style; callback shims provided".

aj: Approved. Merge when CI is green.

ci-bot: All checks green. Merged PR 7 into `main`.

maria: Thanks! I'll schedule a small announcement tomorrow and drop the snippets into the SDK migration checklist. Closing thread. :tada:
